csv_project_name: Design Services For Dickinson City Entrance Signs
csv_scope_of_work: The City desires to construct an entrance sign that functions as a welcoming gateway feature, reflects the City s identity, and is suitable for the selected location. The objective of this procurement is to secure a qualified contractor that can convert the City s initial concept into a final, constructible sign package and complete the work through installation. The City of Dickinson is solicitating proposals for qualified contractor that will work jointly with a qualified architecture firm, of their choice, to offer professional design services to refine a City-provided entrance sign concept; prepare near photo-realistic renderings, architectural/construction drawings, and ND DOT-acceptable supporting documents; and fabricate and install the sign on an estimated Time and Material, not to exceed, basis.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Graphic Design/Public Art
